function.description: Send a message to a specified Slack channel. This tool posts a message to a public channel, private channel, direct message, or multi-person direct message.
function.name: send_message

attachments.description: An array of legacy attachment objects. Prefer using Block Kit blocks for new integrations.

color.description: A hex color code (e.g., #36a64f) or predefined good/warning/danger.

blocks.description: An array of Block Kit layout blocks that define the visual structure of the message.

block_id.description: A unique identifier for the block, used for interaction payloads.

text.description: The text object for the block content.

channel.description: The channel ID, private group ID, or user ID to send the message to. Can be an encoded ID (e.g., C123456) or a channel name.

reply_broadcast.description: Used in conjunction with thread_ts and indicates whether reply should be made visible to everyone in the channel or conversation.

text.description: The main text of the message. This field is required and supports Slack's mrkdwn formatting for bold, italic, strikethrough, links, and channel/user references.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply in a thread. Do not use the reply_broadcast parameter when also setting thread_ts.

unfurl_links.description: Pass true to enable unfurling of primarily text-based content.

unfurl_media.description: Pass false to disable unfurling of media content.
